== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Final Sword is a powerful combat [[technique]] utilized by [[Yerin]]. It involves condensing [[madra]], [[aura]], and sometimes [[soulfire]] into a massive, translucent replica of her actual weapon. While the [[technique]] can manifest as a large, hazy blade with a hilt and guard, it has also appeared as a beam of red-chrome energy that sounds like an explosion or a roar. The [[technique]] is highly destructive, capable of carving through massive creatures, tearing trenches in the earth, and piercing through protective barriers. Its effectiveness can vary based on environmental factors like [[aura]] availability; for instance, it is more difficult to use in [[aura]]-depleted locations. Other entities have demonstrated variations of this [[technique]], including [[Ruby]], who can perform a version using [[blood madra]], and [[Yerin]]'s parasite, which also possesses its own version. The [[technique]] is closely associated with the [[Death Icon]] and was developed in conjunction with [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]].}}
